subject: Penetration test report & SIG/CAIQ items - Greenfield Health
messages:
From: Tom Wexler <tom.wexler@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: vendor-security@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Penetration testing artifacts needed for SIG/CAIQ - Redwood

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. Greenfield's vendor risk team is finalizing the SIG/CAIQ review and needs the following artifacts to close our assessment: the most recent penetration test (executive summary or redacted full report), a remediation log with status and ticket links, and confirmation of the pen test scope (networks, public endpoints, third-party dependencies). We also need you to paste the key findings into our GRC spreadsheet so we can map them to SIG questions (link below).

Can you provide:
- Redacted pen test report or executive summary (PDF)
- Remediation spreadsheet with status for each finding (xlsx)
- Brief note on scope (dates, in-scope hosts/services, whether cloud infra/managed services were included)

We can accept the artifacts uploaded to the spreadsheet or a secure link. If you need an NDA for the full report, let me know and I can send DocuSign. Our deadline to close the review is EOW next Friday (2026-11-27).

GRC spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GfGreenfieldGRCsheet-id

Thanks,
Tom Wexler
Vendor Risk Lead
Greenfield Health
vendor-security@greenfieldhealth.com

--

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Wexler <tom.wexler@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Penetration testing artifacts needed for SIG/CAIQ - Redwood

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list and the timeline. We can absolutely provide a redacted pen test summary plus a remediation tracker by EOW next Friday. A few quick points:

- We ran a third-party penetration assessment in August 2026 (scope: public-facing APIs, customer-facing web portal, authentication flows; internal LAN and backend services were out-of-scope).
- We will prepare a redacted executive PDF that removes IP addresses and any customer-identifying info.
- Evelyn (cc'd) will attach our current remediation log and status.
- If you need the full, unredacted report, please send over an NDA/DocuSign and we can arrange secure transfer.

I'll upload the redacted PDF and remediation spreadsheet to the GRC sheet and send copies to this thread once done. Let us know if you prefer SFTP instead of the Drive link.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Pen test artifacts and redaction checklist for Greenfield

Soojin / Dev — attaching the remediation log and a short scope note so you can populate the GRC sheet.

Summary for paste:
- Assessment vendor: GreyOak Security (contracted)
- Engagement dates: 2026-08-02 to 2026-08-06
- In-scope: public API endpoints (api.redwood.ai), web console (console.redwood.ai), authentication flow (OAuth2).
- Out-of-scope: internal CI/CD infrastructure, partner-managed storage, third-party analytics service (see report appendix).
- Critical findings: 1) auth token session fixation (fixed, deployed 2026-08-18), 2) S3 ACL misconfiguration on dev bucket (fixed, 2026-09-02), 3) rate-limiting bypass (mitigated via WAF rules, 2026-08-21).

Attachments: redwood-remediation-log-2026-11.xlsx (contains ticket IDs and current status), redwood-pt-summary-2026-11-redacted.pdf (draft). Please verify redactions: remove exact IPs, customer names, sample request bodies that include PII.

If Greenfield needs the original report under NDA, ping legal and I'll coordinate.

Evelyn Hart
Security Manager | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: redwood-remediation-log-2026-11.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), redwood-pt-summary-2026-11-redacted.pdf (application/pdf)
